description: UNDERSTANDING — What is NEW for a saved search since you last checked: providers that newly match your criteria. Advances the delta cursor, so each call reports only what changed since the previous call. The agent-native version of the demand report. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.
